goal: Step a Foundry organization through its modeled lifecycle, so it is activated, suspended or retired only by its own distinct administrators with full coverage.

app.name: foundry-org-lifecycle
app.title: Organization lifecycle
app.purpose: Give the next lifecycle state of a Foundry organization from its current state, the requested transition, whose administrators approve it, how many distinct administrators approve and whether they cover every part.

fields.name: scope
fields.means: whether the approving administrators belong to this organization or another one

fields.name: administrators
fields.means: distinct users approving; aliases, extra keys and duplicate approvals count once

fields.name: coverage
fields.means: whether administrators cover every part of the organization

meanings.provisional: created by any enrolled user, with only the creator's provisional grants
meanings.retired: retired with its audit logs kept, the final state

rules.why: model/organization_lifecycle.toml: provisional to activated only after distinct-user multi-admin quorum coverage (activation_minimum_distinct_administrators = 2); SPEC.md: complete administrative coverage
model/organization_lifecycle.toml: an activated organization may be suspended by authorized distinct administrators (minimum 2)
model/organization_lifecycle.toml: a suspended organization may be reactivated (minimum 2 distinct administrators)
model/organization_lifecycle.toml: an activated organization may be retired, keeping its audit logs (minimum 2 distinct administrators)
model/organization_lifecycle.toml: allowed_transitions lists no other move out of activated
model/organization_lifecycle.toml: allowed_transitions lists only reactivation out of suspended
model/organization_lifecycle.toml: allowed_transitions lists no move out of retired

app.otherwiseWhy: model/organization_lifecycle.toml: allow_sole_founding_admin_in_provisional; a provisional organization without quorum and coverage stays provisional

properties.why: a sole founding administrator is a bootstrap condition, not accepted redundancy
activation needs complete administrative coverage of the organization's parts
creation never gives authority over another organization
retirement is allowed only from activated

stakeholders.name: Organization founder
stakeholders.text: Enrolls, creates an organization with any display name and needs it to activate once a second administrator covers every part.

stakeholders.name: Organization administrator
stakeholders.text: Approves suspension, reactivation and retirement and needs no single user or other organization to move the organization alone.

components.name: Foundry portal
components.text: The browser portal whose Views request lifecycle transitions.

components.name: Foundry authority model
components.text: model/authority.toml, the scoped multi-administrator policy that counts distinct approvers.

threats.name: Single-owner activation
threats.text: The sole founding administrator activates the organization without a second distinct user.

control.name: Distinct-user quorum
control.text: Activation needs two distinct administrators and complete coverage.

threats.name: Cross-organization retirement
threats.text: Administrators of another organization, possibly one with an identical display name, retire this one.

control.name: Organization isolation
control.text: Only this organization's administrators move it.

evidence.reference: UOR-Foundation/uor-foundry SPEC.md: names confer no privileges

threats.name: Duplicate approvals counted
threats.text: Aliases or extra keys of one user are counted as several administrators.
threats.accepted: The app is given the count of distinct users; deduplicating aliases and keys belongs to the authority model that sends it, per SPEC.md.

quality.text: Every transition out of a state needs at least the minimum_distinct_administrators of model/organization_lifecycle.toml.
quality.measureText: Fewest distinct administrators any allowed transition accepts.

quality.text: Each of the four allowed_transitions rows is one rule of the machine.
